proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.within_feet_of_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation gate depends on proximity to a placed magic item, which is not representable by the current holding/wearing/wielding predicate vocabulary.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action...

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics item-rooted spawn placement
proposed_widenings.justification: The summoned creature appears relative to the brazier rather than relative to the activator, but the current spawned-creature shape only exposes a coarse activator-rooted range header.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible...

notes: Authored as magic_item + spawned_creature and it typechecks/traces. Outcome is not clean because the surface cannot encode the 5-foot proximity gate or the item-rooted nearest-space placement rule. Secondary omissions: catalog_ref cannot express 'understands your languages', and CreatureControl forced conservative placeholders for unspecified command range/default behavior.
